title: Netflix Replaces Chief Content Officer, Lays Off About 1,000 Employees
content: Netflix 's co-founder and former chairman of the board Reed Hastings left the company in June. Hastings and Marc Randolph co-founded Netflix in 1997, and the company first offered DVD rentals via mail to customers, before transitioning to streaming.
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll Manga Adds New Titles in New October 2026 Update
content: As the largest platform for anime fans across the globe, Crunchyroll ‘s services aren’t limited to streaming shows and movies. The platform offers an expansive library of anime shows and movies for fans across the world, along with merchandise and home video releases.
author: ComicBook

title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2 Is the Sequel You Didn’t Know You Needed (Review)
content: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners ended in as complete of a way as any anime project could ask for. It had a central cast of characters that all found their respective ends, and it thematically wrapped with a look into the future.
author: ComicBook

title: Jump Festa 2027 Confirms Packed Schedule With Major Anime & Manga Reveals Teased
content: Shueisha’s next Jump Festa event is fast approaching, and now the publisher has confirmed the full schedule for the event with a tease of some of the major franchises that will have something on offer later this year.
author: ComicBook

title: My Hero Academia Spinoff Gets New Streaming Home With Major Update
content: Written and illustrated by Kohei Horikoshi, My Hero Academia remains one of the most successful anime and manga franchises of all time. While the main story is long over, fans always have something new to look forward to.
author: ComicBook

title: Actor Michael Forest Dies at 97
content: Forest had numerous roles in live-action television series and anime. His television roles include Apollo in Star Trek , Father Joe Coogan in The Dick Van Dyke Show , Anastacio in Zorro , Steve in the "Black Leather Jackets" episode of The Twilight Zone , and Olympius in Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue .
author: ANN

title: 19 Years Later, Cancelled Shonen Jump Series Returns With English Dub for Anime Revival
content: A major Shonen Jump series has kicked off its official anime revival 19 years after it was originally cancelled, and Crunchyroll has now starting to release the official English dub for the new anime series.
author: ComicBook

title: One Piece’s Luffy Became a Real Captain With This Major Turning Point (& It’s a Fan-Favorite Arc)
content: Monkey D. Luffy started off as a pure-hearted youngster that yearned to become King of Pirates when One Piece kicked off 30 years ago . He quickly gained the audience’s adulation, taking down villains and scrounging together an unlikely crew.
author: ComicBook

title: The Simpsons’ New Apu Breaks Silence on Taking Over Role (& Explains Casting Process)
content: The Simpsons has officially reintroduced Apu back into the animated series with Season 38’s newest episode, and the new voice star behind the role has opened up about joining the long running series and explaining how the secretive casting process for the character worked out.
author: ComicBook

title: CloverWorks' Omnibus Anime Film Grotesqqque Streams 'Yoroshiku★Girl' Segment Early on Netflix for Limited Time
content: The official website for Atsushi Nishigori 's original anime film Grotesqqque (previously titled Grotesque) announced on Monday that the film's "Yoroshiku★Girl" segment will stream early for a limited time on Netflix in Japan from October 23-November 5, before the film opens on November 6.
author: ANN
